headline_pain: Developers Don't Need It. You Do.
primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." Think about that — you're competing against people who don't even need the space. They just want the land. Meanwhile, your business needs a home. We built these Truganina warehouses specifically so small businesses can buy without fighting developers. Off-the-plan pricing, transparent process, owner-occupier priority. Right near Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel, 20km from the CBD. Your business deserves a permanent home. Not another lost auction.
description: Purpose-built for businesses that actually use the space — not land-banking developers.
